text:
anya: FYI customer 'PaperTrail' seeing intermittent 403s after our service key rotation last night. They say it works for a bit then 403s start. They supplied two request ids: req_0a3b9c and req_0a3bff. can someone grab repro steps?
sam: do we have the exact curl they used or a trace? 403 could be cached old key at edge or org header mismatch.
anya: they only sent an example curl that hits our api gateway: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer svc_live_XXXX" \n -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-papertrail" \n https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'```
frank: thanks. any response headers from those req ids? gateway usually returns x-rw-req, x-rw-sig-info when signature fails.
anya: paste from customer logs: ```HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2025 08:22:13 GMT
x-rw-req: req_0a3b9c
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "message": "servicekey org mismatch or revoked"
}```
frank: that message matches 'org mismatch' branch. Could be cached servicekey in a long-lived proxy pool still routing with old org mapping. Did they rotate keys and keep the same token id?
anya: yes they rotated, old key id was svc_abc, new is svc_def, but they rotated via dashboard at 02:14 UTC and a rolling proxy refresh should have cleared.
infra-bot: automated note: double-checking cache invalidation logs for proxy fleet. Correlation id: corr_9f7.
devon: if it's a cached key, repro is easy: make two requests quickly — one to succeed, then after rotation you'll see a window where some backends still accept old mapping and others reject. we need the raw req headers + the ``Authorization`` bearer token prefix (last 8 chars ok) and the x-rw-req returned.
sam: can customer send: 1) exact curl (with masked token allowed, keep first/last 4 chars), 2) the full response headers for a failing req, 3) the x-rw-req value and timestamp. also request they run our debug bundle generator: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/support/debug-bundle -o dbg.json``` and attach dbg.json.
anya: forwarded those steps. customer replied with another failing req id: req_0a3bff and this small internal log from their side showing a proxy hung on old mapping: ```[proxy-42] 2025-06-18T08:22:14Z accepted token svc_abc for org-papertrail (cached) then forwarded -> gateway returned 403 org-mismatch req=req_0a3bff```
frank: good repro. next steps: ask eng-infra to search proxy cache invalidation logs around 02:14 UTC for stale entries and route-level config. Also we should verify our gateway returns x-rw-sig-info with failure reasons — looks like it did not for req_0a3b9c. file a ticket with request ids and svc key ids.
devon: quick debug we can ask customer to run a controlled test: 5 quick requests before rotation, rotate, then 20 requests over 5 minutes capturing x-rw-req headers. that'll show distribution of failures vs backends.
anya: customer agreed to run and will attach dbg.json + list of x-rw-reqs. I'll collect and ping eng-infra. tagging @sam when bundle ready. :thumbsup:
sam: once we have dbg.json and req ids I'll escalate to infra with case link. also please include which region (they said eu-west-1) and whether they're on Dedicated vs Hosted.
infra-bot: note: recommended temporary mitigation - revoke old key and ensure rotation enforces immediate proxy cache invalidation for servicekey->org mapping. creating internal ticket INFRA-7629.
frank: thanks. logging this thread in support tracker. if we need a curl repro from our side we can emulate with a masked token and force route through eu gateways to reproduce.
anya: attaching customer reply ETA ~20m. I'll update here when dbg bundle + req list arrives.
sam: sounds good. keep short notes here and include request ids in the ticket.
anya: (added) customer sent dbg bundle link: https://files.papertrail.example/dbg-185012.zip (I told them to upload to secure support storage). they also included req_0a3b9c, req_0a3bff, req_0a3c007. grabbing now.
frank: perfect — once you upload the dbg.json to the case, I'll run a quick correlation on gateway logs and reply with confirmation if it's stale-proxy cache or gateway config.
anya: uploaded dbg.json to the support case and updated INFRA-7629 with the req ids. closing loop here once infra confirms. :white_check_mark:
